title: User Authentication with Valid Credentials
description: Verify that users can log in successfully using valid credentials and appropriate role assignment.

steps.description: Navigate to login page
Enter email 'testadmin@tapan-cargo.test' and password 'TestAdmin2024!'
Submit login form
Verify successful login and fetching of user session data
Verify user role is correctly set and accessible

title: User Authentication with Invalid Credentials
description: Ensure that login fails with incorrect credentials and proper error message is shown.

steps.description: Navigate to login page
Enter invalid email or password
Submit login form
Verify login failure and display of appropriate error message

title: Role-Based Access Control Enforcement
description: Validate that users can only access API endpoints and UI components allowed for their assigned roles.

steps.description: Log in with email 'testadmin@tapan-cargo.test' and password 'TestAdmin2024!'
Attempt to access admin-only shipment creation endpoint
Verify access is denied
Access allowed shipment viewing endpoint
Verify access is permitted and data is correct

title: Shipment Creation with Valid Data
description: Confirm that shipments can be created with correct origin, destination, and transport mode inputs and an ETA is calculated.

steps.description: Log in with email 'testadmin@tapan-cargo.test' and password 'TestAdmin2024!'
Navigate to /dashboard/shipments/new

Fill sender name using [data-testid='shipment-sender-name'], sender phone, receiver name using [data-testid='shipment-receiver-name'], receiver phone, select origin and destination from dropdowns, enter weight using [data-testid='shipment-weight']
Click submit button [data-testid='shipment-submit-button']
Verify shipment is created successfully with unique shipment reference
Verify ETA is calculated and returned

title: Shipment Creation with Missing Required Fields
description: Ensure that shipment creation fails with appropriate error messages when required data is missing.

steps.description: Log in with email 'testadmin@tapan-cargo.test' and password 'TestAdmin2024!'
Navigate to /dashboard/shipments/new
Leave sender name [data-testid='shipment-sender-name'] empty, fill other fields
Click submit button [data-testid='shipment-submit-button']
Verify form validation error for missing origin field

title: Barcode Generation GS1 Compliant
description: Verify GS1-compliant barcode generation for SSCC-18 and GTIN-14 types for shipments.

steps.description: Request GS1 SSCC barcode generation for a valid shipment
Validate generated barcode matches SSCC-18 format and standards
Request GS1 GTIN-14 barcode generation for same shipment
Validate generated barcode complies with GTIN-14 formatting rules

title: Barcode Generation with Invalid Parameters
description: Ensure barcode generation fails gracefully with appropriate error when invalid or missing parameters are submitted.

steps.description: Make a barcode generation request without required barcode number or type
Verify error response with descriptive message

title: Package Scan Event Recording
description: Record package scan events with valid barcodes and track shipment progress updating in real-time shipment timeline.

steps.description: Scan a valid barcode for a package
Send scan event with scan type, location, and operator ID to scan API
Verify scan event is recorded with correct shipment linkage
View shipment timeline
Confirm real-time update of package location and status

title: Inventory Stock Adjustment Inbound
description: Test increasing inventory stock for items with correct stock level updates and real-time reflection.

steps.description: Log in with email 'testadmin@tapan-cargo.test' and password 'TestAdmin2024!'
Submit inventory adjustment request with inbound type, valid SKU, quantity, and location
Verify inventory stock is incremented by requested amount
Verify stock update is reflected in API response and inventory listing

title: Inventory Adjustment with Invalid Quantity
description: Verify system prevents inventory adjustment when quantity is zero or negative.

steps.description: Submit inventory adjustment with quantity zero or negative value
Verify error response and no stock update occurs

title: Low Stock Alert Generation
description: Validate that low stock alerts are generated correctly when inventory falls below threshold.

steps.description: Adjust inventory quantity to just above low stock threshold
Confirm no low stock alert is triggered
Adjust inventory quantity below low stock threshold
Verify low stock alert notification is generated

title: Invoice Creation with GST Calculations
description: Verify invoice creation includes correct freight amount, GST percent, calculates totals, and links to shipment.

steps.description: Log in with email 'testadmin@tapan-cargo.test' and password 'TestAdmin2024!'
Create an invoice with valid customer ID, shipment ID, freight amount and GST percent
Verify invoice is saved with correct GST calculations
Verify invoice is linked to the corresponding shipment

title: Invoice PDF Generation and Branding
description: Test generating PDF invoice with accurate data and company branding elements included.

steps.description: Request PDF generation for a valid invoice ID
Verify PDF is generated successfully
Verify PDF content includes company branding and accurate invoice data

title: Invoice Delivery via WhatsApp and SMS
description: Ensure invoices can be sent through WhatsApp Business API and SMS with confirmation of delivery.

steps.description: Trigger invoice delivery via WhatsApp API
Verify delivery success response and message ID
Trigger invoice delivery via SMS channel
Verify SMS sent confirmation

title: Financial Reporting Accounts Receivable Summary Accuracy
description: Validate that accounts receivable summary and aging reports accurately reflect invoice and payment data.

steps.description: Access accounts receivable summary page
Verify total outstanding, current, and overdue aging buckets (30, 60, 90 days) match expected values

title: Public Shipment Tracking without Authentication
description: Test shipment tracking portal with shipment reference, invoice reference, and barcode query terms returns accurate and complete shipment status without login.

steps.description: Use public tracking API with valid shipment reference
Verify shipment found and status and timeline are correct
Repeat with valid invoice reference
Verify correct shipment data is returned
Repeat with valid barcode
Verify shipment status and package scan timeline are returned accurately
Query with invalid reference
Verify response indicates shipment not found

title: API Response Time Under Load
description: Ensure all APIs respond within 500ms under normal and peak load with at least 100 concurrent users.

steps.description: Simulate 100 concurrent users making requests to multiple key APIs
Monitor response times and confirm 99% of responses are within 500ms

title: Rate Limiting Enforcement on APIs
description: Verify rate limiting is enforced to prevent API abuse as per defined thresholds.

steps.description: Make rapid successive API calls exceeding rate limit
Verify API returns rate limit exceeded error with proper status code
Wait for rate limit reset window and retry requests
Verify requests succeed after reset period

title: System Uptime and Error Monitoring
description: Validate that system uptime meets 99.9% target and error events are tracked via Sentry with performance analytics monitored in Vercel Analytics.

steps.description: Simulate normal and error-producing interactions
Check Sentry dashboard for logged errors
Review Vercel Analytics for uptime and performance metrics

title: Customer Detail Update with Valid Data
description: Confirm users can update customer information such as contact, GST number, and address with valid data persistency.

steps.description: Log in with email 'testadmin@tapan-cargo.test' and password 'TestAdmin2024!'
Submit update for existing customer with valid modified fields
Verify customer details are updated correctly in database
Verify updated details are reflected in customer detail views

title: Search Functionality Across Shipments, Invoices, and Customers
description: Verify global search returns accurate results filtered by query string and optional type parameter.

steps.description: Perform search with query string for shipment ref
Verify matching shipments are returned
Perform search with query string and type=invoice
Verify only invoices matching the query are returned
Perform search with query string and type=customer
Verify matching customer results are returned

title: Manifest Creation and Update
description: Ensure creation and updating of air cargo manifests works correctly with required fields and shipment grouping.

steps.description: Log in with email 'testadmin@tapan-cargo.test' and password 'TestAdmin2024!'
Create new manifest with valid origin hub, destination, and flight details
Verify manifest is created successfully
Update existing manifest data
Verify manifest updates are saved correctly

title: Payment Recording Against Invoice
description: Test recording payments linked to invoices with various modes and verify payment tracking.

steps.description: Record payment with valid invoice ID, amount, and payment mode
Verify payment entry is recorded and invoice balance updates accordingly
Record payment with missing invoice ID
Verify error response indicating required invoice ID is missing
